hero.campaign-heroes.finneasVilmar.speci: Casts Animate Dead with effect increased by 5% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.campaign-heroes.generalKendal.speci: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.campaign-heroes.ordwald.specialty.d: Casts Slayer with effect increased by 20 for level 1–2 creatures, by 16 for level 3–4 creatures, by 12 for level 5–6 creatures, and by 8 for level 7 creatures.
hero.campaign-heroes.youngAlkin.specialt: Increases the Speed of allied Gorgons, Mighty Gorgons, and Corrosive Gorgons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.campaign-heroes.youngCatherine.spec: Increases the Speed of allied Swordsmen, Crusaders, and Guardsmen by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.campaign-heroes.youngChristian.spec: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
